intervention: metformin 1500 mg daily vs placebo for 26 weeks
main_result: no difference in change in endogenous glucose production between metformin and placebo (p = 0.53)
note: 20 adults without diabetes took part in a separate baseline cross-sectional comparison; they were not randomised. 37 of 40 completed.

population: women aged 40-60 with overweight or obesity in Hong Kong
intervention: 8-hour flexible time-restricted eating and aerobic exercise alone or combined vs control for 12 weeks
main_result: combined time-restricted eating plus exercise reduced fat mass most: -2.85 kg vs control

population: extremely low birthweight infants under 1000 g
intervention: liberal vs restrictive red blood cell transfusion thresholds
main_result: time with intermittent hypoxaemia was similar between groups (0.91% vs 0.79%)
note: Secondary analysis of 554 of the 1013 infants in the ETTNO trial; 268 liberal and 286 restrictive.

population: very low birth weight preterm infants
intervention: enteral bovine lactoferrin 150 mg/kg/day vs placebo for four weeks

population: breast cancer patients receiving paclitaxel chemotherapy
intervention: hand and foot gradient pressure therapy added to routine care
main_result: reduced neuropathy symptoms and impact on daily activities from the fourth cycle onwards
note: Title says case-control but patients were randomly divided into two groups of 40.

intervention: white bread from high-amylose (sbeII mutant) wheat flour vs white bread from wild-type flour
main_result: no difference in maximum glucose rise within 2 hours (mean difference -0.08 mmol/L, p = 0.514)
note: Two-period crossover: each participant ate both breads. 26 enrolled, one withdrew. In vitro starch digestion differed, but that is not the trial outcome.

population: women aged 50-74 living more than 15 minutes from a radiology centre in Normandy
intervention: appointment at a mobile mammography unit in addition to the usual screening invitation
note: 320 areas were the randomised clusters; 87449 women lived in them.

population: postmenopausal women aged 45-65 with moderate or severe vasomotor symptoms
intervention: 12-week combined resistance and aerobic training vs control
main_result: large improvement in vasomotor symptom severity (p < 0.001)

population: employees of 15 workplaces in three Chinese cities
main_result: high prevalence of cancer risk factors with regional variation
note: Baseline data of a stepped-wedge cluster randomised trial; this analysis itself is cross-sectional with no intervention.

population: patients undergoing minimally invasive cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass
intervention: continuous furosemide infusion during bypass vs none
note: No significant reduction in AKI; urine output and PaO2/FiO2 higher with furosemide.
